a: संमा — {c3c} A., {c2c} P. 1 To measure. --2 To make equal, equalize; see संमित. --3 To liken, compare. --4 To be comprised or contained in; मृणालसूत्रमपि ते न संमाति स्तनांतरे Subhāṣ. --5 To distribute, grant, bestow (Ved.)
संमादः — Intoxication, frenzy.
संमानः — Honour, respect. --नं 1 A measure. --2 Comparing.
संमाननं — 1 Honouring, worshipping. --2 Instructing, teaching.
संमार्जकः — A sweeper.
संमार्जनी — A broom.
संमार्जनं — 1 Sweeping, cleaning. --2 Purifying, cleaning, brushing. --3 Anointing (of images).
संमातुर — = सन्मातुर q. v. under सत्.

संमील् — {c1c} P. 1 To shut the eyes. --2 To close up, contract (as flowers &c.); संमीलंति न तावद्बंधनकोषास्तयावचितपुष्पाः Ś. 3. 6. --Caus. 1 To shut, close; उपांतसंमीलितलो चनो नृपः R. 3. 26; 13. 10. --2 To obscure, darken, make dim; विकारश्चैतन्यं भ्रमयति च संमीलयति च U. 1. 36. --3 To make insensible.
संमीलनं — Closing up(of a flower &c.), covering, enveloping.
संमूढ — p. p. 1 Stupefied, unconscious, senseless. --2 Infatuated, foolish. --3 Bewildered. --4 Disordered. --5 Heaped, collected. --6 Produced rapidly. --7 Broken. --ढा A kind of riddle.
संमूर्छनं — 1 Fainting, insensibility. --2 Congealing, becoming dense. --3 Thickening, increasing. --4 Height. --5 Universal pervasion, co-extension, complete permeation.
संमंत्र् — {c10c} A. 1 To consult or take counsel with; मम हृदयेन सह संमंत्रयोक्तवानसि Mu. 1. --2 To salute, greet.
संमंत्रणं — Consultation.
संमद् — {c4c} P. 1 To be intoxicated. --2 To rejoice, be glad. --Caus. 1 To exhilarate, rejoice, put in good spirits. --2 To be completely intoxicated (Atm).
संमद — a. Greatly delighted, happy, --दः Great joy, delight, happiness; Śi. 15. 77.

संमन् — {c4c} A. 1 To agree, concur, be of the same opinion. --2 To assent or consent to, approve of, like. --3 To think, suppose, regard. --4 To sanction, authorize. --5 To esteem, honour, value highly; कच्चिदग्निमिवानाय्यं काले संप्रन्यसेऽतिथिं Bk. 6. 65; सममंस्त बंधूत् 1. 2. --6 To allow, permit. --Caus. 1 To honour, respect, value highly. --2 To consider, regard. --3 To instruct, teach.

v: pu॰ sam + mfda--GaY । anyonyadfQasaMyogarUpe saMkzarze vA maH
a: संमर्दः — 1 Rubbing together, friction. --2 Throng, crowd, concourse; यद्गोप्रतरकल्पोऽभूत्संमर्दस्तत्र मज्जतां R. 15. 101; Māl. 10. --3 Treading or trampling on. --4 War, battle.

संमत — p. p. 1 Agreed or consented to, approved of. --2 Liked, dear, beloved; R. 1. 28. --3 Like, resembling. --4 Regarded, considered, thought. --5 Highly respected, honoured, esteemed; Pt. 1. 56. --तं 1 Agreement; see संमति. --2 Impression, opinion.

संमतिः — f. 1 Agreement. --2 Concurrence, assent, approbation, approval. --3 Wish, desire. --4 Knowledge of self, knowledge of the soul, true knowledge. --5 Regard, respect, esteem; कथमिव तव संमतिर्भवित्रा सममृतुभिर्मुनिनावधीरितस्य Ki. 10. 36. --6 Love, affection. --7 Command, order.
संमत्त — p. p. 1 Completely drunk. --2 Overjoyed, enraptured. --3 Rutting, being in rut, furious.
संमेलनं — 1 Meeting together, union. --2 Mixture. --3 Assembling, collecting.
संमृद् — {c1c} {c9c} P. 1 To press or squeeze together, rub or grind to pieces; crush, trample upon. --2 To pound, bruise, kill. --Caus. 1 To crush, pound &c. --2 To rub. --3 To clean.
संमृज् — {c2c} P., {c10c} U. 1 To sweep clean, purify. --2 To wipe off or out, wipe away, remove. --3 To rub, stroke. --4 To strain, filter.
संमृत — a. Quite dead, deceased.
संमृष्ट — p. p. 1 Well swept, cleansed. --2 Strained, filtered.
संमिश्लः — An epithet of Indra.
संमिश्र् — See मिश्र्.
संमिश्र, संमिश्रित — a. Mixed together, intermixed.
संमिल् — {c6c} P. To meet or come together, assemble.

संमित — p. p. 1 Meted, measured out. --2 Of equal measure, extent or value, equal, similar, like, resembling; कांतासंमिततयो पदेशयुजे K. P. 1; R. 3. 16. --3 As large as, reaching to. --4 Conformable, corresponding, commensurate. --5 Provided or furnished with. --6 Equalized, adapted.
संमोदः — Great joy, delight.
संमोहः — 1 Bewilderment, confusion, infatuation. --2 Insensibility, swoon. --3 Ignorance, folly. --4 Fascination. --5 Tumult, battle.
संमोहनं — Fascinating, fascination. --नः N. of one of the five arrows of Cupid; Ku. 3. 66.

संमुख — a. (खा or खी f.), संमुखीन a. 1 Facing, fronting, face to face, opposite, con fronting; कामं न तिष्ठति मदाननसंमुखी सा Ś. 1. 31; R. 15. 17; Śi. 10. 86. --2 Encountering, meeting. --3 Disposed to. --4 Looking or directed towards. --5 Propitious. --खं ind. In front of, opposite to, before, in the presence of.
संमुखिन् — m. A mirror, lookingglass.
संमुग्ध — p. p. 1 Stupefied. --2 Bewildered. --3 Beautiful. --ग्धं ind. In a fascinating manner.
संमुह् — {c4c} P. 1 To be perplexed. --2 To be foolish, infatuated, or unconscious. --Caus. To infatuate, stupefy.
संमुर्च्छ् — {c1c} A. 1 To faint, swoon. --2 To grow strong or powerful, gather strength, become intense; Ki. 5. 41. --3 To thicken; coagulate. --Caus. 1 To form, fashion. --2 To stupefy, benumb.
